verdicts.reason: A works as a clean left-to-right leaderboard: the phone sits in its circle, the brand, one-line headline and subhead are stacked, the badges are stacked in the middle and the CTA sits on the right. Its flaws are small: the phone is very small, the circle is cropped at the top and bottom, and the badges sit apart from the copy. B has a large empty gap between the phone and the text. SOLSTICE floats off to the left of the headline, the two-line headline is cramped against the top edge, and the subhead is tiny. Its CTA is jammed under the 'Back by demand' badge in a crowded 2x2 cluster, and the CTA is no wider than that badge, so the call to action loses its prominence and the right side ends with an empty gap.
